description_en: Queries the billing type of a user. You can query data for up to one month
description_zh: 调用DescribeCdnUserBillType查询用户计费类型，最多查询一个月的数据
name: DescribeCdnUserBillType

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the data to retrieve. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The minimum data granularity is 5 minutes
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据起始时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

最小数据粒度为5分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the data to retrieve. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据结束时间。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time

BillTypeDataItem.description_en: The returned data of user billing types
BillTypeDataItem.description_zh: 用户计费类型返回数据

BillType.description_en:
The metering method.

A value with the _overseas suffix indicates that billing for regions outside China is not divided by region. For example, "BillType": "month_avg_day_bandwidth_overseas" indicates that the metering method is monthly average daily peak bandwidth for regions outside China, and the billing is not divided by region.

Valid values:
hour_flow: billed by hourly data transfer
day_bandwidth: billed by daily bandwidth
month_95: billed by monthly 95th percentile bandwidth
month_avg_day_bandwidth: billed by monthly average daily peak bandwidth
month_4th_day_bandwidth: billed by peak bandwidth on the fourth day of each month
month_avg_day_95: billed by monthly average daily 95th percentile bandwidth
month_95_night_half: billed by 95th percentile bandwidth with a 50% discount during nighttime
hour_vas: billed by hourly value-added services
quic_hour_count: billed by hourly QUIC requests
day_count: billed by daily requests
hour_count: billed by hourly requests
day_95: billed by daily 95th percentile bandwidth
BillType.description_zh:
计费模式。

带_overseas后缀表示海外不分大区计费，例如："BillType": "month_avg_day_bandwidth_overseas" 则表明该计费方式为月均日峰值海外不分区计费。

计费模式取值如下所示：
hour_flow：按小时流量计费。
day_bandwidth：按日带宽计费。
month_95：按月结95峰值带宽计费。
month_avg_day_bandwidth：按月均日峰值带宽计费。
month_4th_day_bandwidth：按月第四日峰值带宽计费。
month_avg_day_95：按月均日95峰值带宽计费。
month_95_night_half：按夜间半价95峰值带宽计费。
hour_vas：按小时增值服务计费。
quic_hour_count：按小时QUIC请求数计费。
day_count：按日请求次数计费。
hour_count：按小时请求次数计费。
day_95：按日95峰值带宽计费

Dimension.description_en:
The dimension. Valid values:
flow: traffic and bandwidth
vas: value-added services (HTTPS and dynamic requests)
quic: QUIC requests
websocket: WebSocket communication protocol
rtlog2sls: real-time log delivery to Simple Log Service
stationflow: internal network traffic billing
Dimension.description_zh:
维度。取值如下所示：
flow：流量带宽。
vas：增值服务（https、动态请求）。
quic：QUIC 请求数。
websocket：websocket通信协议。
rtlog2sls：实时日志推送sls。
stationflow：流量内网化计费

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the billing method. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard and in UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 计费模式结束时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the billing method. The time is in the ISO 8601 standard and in UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 计费模式起始时间。时间格式为 ISO 8601，使用 UTC 时间
